answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, slashed on a failed audit, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The shale of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The vine is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the yarrow.
